label: Quest

intro: Following the discovery of strange Rot Hide ichor in Silverpine Forest, Bethor Iceshard identifies the foul substance as the handiwork of his traitorous former colleague, Thule Ravenclaw. To aid the Forsaken in repelling the Rot Hide gnolls, Bethor prepares a specialized scroll containing counter-incantations for Apothecary Renferrel.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This Ichor was crafted by an old colleague of mine: Thule Ravenclaw. He was a young, promising mage before the great war, but when the Lich King rose to power, he betrayed his brethren and allied with the Scourge.
I did not realize he still lives, nor that he leads the Rot Hides in their forays against us!
I know many of his spells, and can help concoct a potion to counter them. Take this scroll back to Apothecary Renferrel. It has the incantations needed for the potion.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings, friend. What did Bethor have to say?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This scroll is laced with powerful magic. I've never used such forces in a potion... It will be a powerful mixture, and should serve you well should you attack Thule in his stronghold on Fenris Isle.
